{{Quote|This stuff for D'Vails?|Lan Crish, to the heroes of Cularin upon their arrival in docking bay 1138|<ref name="Outward Bound" />}}
'''Docking bay 1138''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Taggon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]] that saw operation during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] from the [[Cularin system]] landed a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the docking bay that was laden with a cargo of explosives. The operatives were then confronted in the bay by members of the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Brotherhood]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group who sought to steal the munitions.

==Description==
[[Hangar/Legends|Docking bay]] 1138 was a landing bay located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Taggon]] on the southern continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]], situated near to the coastline of a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Color/Legends|blue]]-colored [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]. It consisted of a private, walled bay that could be used by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] as a place to land, load and drop off cargo. It was kept in a clean condition and a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] was retained in the bay for transporting goods to and from starships that docked there.<ref name="Outward Bound" />

==History==
The docking bay was operated on Druckenwell during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Outward Bound" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[Looking In: Outward Bound]]'' is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the [[heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], landed in the bay onboard a starship laden with a cargo of [[Naescorcom/Legends|Naescorcom]]-made explosives. The agents had been hired by the shipping company [[Renna's Transport Service]] to deliver the weapons to [[Amir D'Vail]] of the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] group [[House D'Vails]], however the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Brotherhood]] sought to steal the weapons for their own purposes. As the freelance operatives exited their ship, a group of the pirates led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lan Crish]] approached, posing as employees of a delivery company hired House D'Vails, and attempted to deceive the freelance agents into handing over the explosives.<ref name="Outward Bound" />

{{RPG|''[[Looking In: Outward Bound]]''}}
The operatives refused to handover their cargo and a fight in the docking bay between the freelance agents and the pirates ensued. The confrontation was broken up by the arrival of the [[Corporate Reaction Force]], Druckenwell's [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] agency, and the pirates were prevented from seizing the munitions. The agents then called up House D'Vails and Amir D'Vail accompanied a group of his employees to the docking bay to thank the operatives and take custody of the shipment.<ref name="Outward Bound" />
{{EndGame}}

A short [[Time/Legends|time]] afterward, the freelance operatives departed docking bay 1138 in their starship and returned to the [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Outward Bound" />

==Behind the scenes==
Docking bay 1138 appeared in ''[[Looking In: Outward Bound]]'' by [[Morrie Mullins]] and [[Lee Pickler]], a [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of the [[Looking In trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign. The adventure suggests that the bay should be portrayed in the role-play as having a similar appearance to [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]],<ref name="Outward Bound" /> a docking bay on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that appears in the movie [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> The docking bay's number, [[1138 (easter egg)|1138]], is term that appears in various ''[[Star Wars]]'' works as a reference to the film [[1971]] film ''[[Wikipedia:THX 1138|THX 1138]]'' by ''Star Wars'' creator [[George Lucas]].<ref name="SW.com 1138">{{SW|url=news/beyond-a-cell-block-references-to-thx-1138-in-star-wars|text=Beyond a Cell Block: References to ''THX 1138'' in ''Star Wars''|nolive=1}}</ref>

In ''Outward Bound'', the players role-play as the heroes of Cularin and their encounter with the Brotherhood pirates in docking bay 1138 can be resolved in various different ways. The player characters can handover the explosives to the Brotherhood or otherwise they can resist the pirates and a fight can break out in the docking bay. The confrontation is resolved with either the player characters or the pirates being defeated and if the fight drags out for a prolonged period of time, the Corporate Reaction Force arrive and break up the struggle.<ref name="Outward Bound" />
